acme_ops: Hey team — after last night's maintenance our app is seeing TLS handshake failures talking to Redwood APIs from our VPC. Started around 03:12 UTC. Error is `TLS handshake timeout` and a handful of 403s. We think our firewall allowlist might be stale. Can you confirm if NAT egress changed on our account?

mike_supp: sorry you're seeing that — fyi this channel has our support oncall. Can you paste a quick curl output showing the egress IP from a host in your VPC? e.g., `curl -s https://ifconfig.me` or `curl -s https://api.ipify.org`

acme_ops: sure — ran from a repro host: `curl -s https://api.ipify.org` -> `34.201.127.8`. Our firewall only has `34.200.44.2` and `34.200.44.3` allowed (from onboarding).

mike_supp: thanks. That matches an IP we started using after a NAT rotation in the POP serving your region. @sara_net can you confirm the scheduled NAT change?

sara_net: confirmed — we did a rolling NAT refresh at 03:05 UTC to reclaim an exhausted ephemeral pool in that AZ. Some customer Private VPCs got new SNAT IPs as part of the rotation. For short-term help, we can either: (1) provide the new egress IP list for your org so you can update your firewall, or (2) pin you to a reserved egress IP / Dedicated NAT (requires provisioning).

acme_ops: we need the full list now so we can update rules ASAP.

sara_net: sending list: `34.201.127.8`, `34.201.127.9` (expected), and a fallback range `34.201.127.0/28` — please add those to your allowlist for the next 24-48h. Also note: our recommendation is to switch to Reserved Egress IPs if you need stable addresses long-term.

mike_supp: quick repro steps you can use to validate egress from multiple hosts:
```
# on each host
curl -s https://api.ipify.org
# alternative DNS-based
dig +short myip.opendns.com @resolver1.opendns.com
```

acme_ops: thanks. We added the /28 and errors dropped immediately. One question — why didn't we get warned about the NAT rotation? We have a change window and expected notice.

sara_net: apologizing for the noise — the rotation was triggered by pool exhaustion due to an unexpected spike in ephemeral allocations in the POP. We have a post-action to add notification for rotations that affect Reserved/Private customers.

tom_devops: for customers needing zero-drift allowlisting we also offer a stable egress option: Reserved Egress (static NAT) or VPC peering + Private Dedicated nodes. For now if you want a stopgap, we can request a short-term static SNAT assignment while you evaluate options. cc @acme_ops — do you want us to request short-term pinning?

acme_ops: yes please, request pinning for 72h while we update our change controls. Also can you share the exact timestamps of the rotation so we can correlate with our logs?

sara_net: rotation started 2026-03-16T03:05:12Z and completed 2026-03-16T03:07:30Z. I'll open an infra ticket to re-assign a temporary SNAT for 72h and follow up here once done.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-9342 created: "Temporary SNAT pin for ACME org (72h)" — assignee: tom_devops.

mike_supp: great — leaving this thread open. If anything resurfaces ping @support and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:

acme_ops: appreciate the fast turnaround, adding you to our change log. Will confirm when long-term Reserved Egress is in place.
